text:
You have a plan! Now it's time to put it into action!

Start with the software: drag your Dataflow program from Lesson 1.3 into your workspace and make any changes you designed, or make the program from scratch!

When you have done that, move on to the hardware: connect your prosthesis to the servo like you planned. When you're ready, connect the servo to the computer, power it up, and see what works!
